thread:
Priya S.: Quick heads-up — partners need clarity on SDK v3 -> v4 breaking change: /predict batch now requires an "items" array of {input, metadata} instead of old flat "inputs" and "batch_id". We need embargo cadence + partner comms plan.
Mike L.: OK what's the minimum notice we're giving partners?
Anya K.: 6 weeks min for SI integrations; marketplace listing needs 8 weeks for validation + docs. :calendar:
Priya S.: Proposed plan: 6-week partner preview (feature flag SDK v4), 4-week opt-in canary, then 2-week general availability. Also 30-day sunset for old clients. Thoughts?
Jordan T.: Risk: hardware partners that depend on old batching semantics (NVIDIA batching shim) will need driver-side retests. Suggest add a "compat-shim" for 90 days.
Eli R.: +1 on shim. We'll maintain server-side compat proxy: /v3-compat that rewrites payloads. Can set quota limits to avoid abuse.
Anya K.: Who's owning partner comms? I can do the partner playbook email. Need a one-pager and migration sample diff.
Priya S.: I'll draft migration diff. Example payloads for README:
```json
// v3
{"inputs": ["a","b"], "batch_id": "abc123"}

// v4
{"items": [{"input":"a","meta":{}},{"input":"b","meta":{}}], "trace_id":"abc123"}
```
Mike L.: We should also include snippet for SDK convenience method: Client.batch_from_inputs([...]) to ease migration.
marketplace-bot: New marketplace rule: breaking-schema changes require a "compatibility badge" and "integration test matrix" before GA listing. See https://marketplace.redwood.ai/partner-guidelines
Jordan T.: Timeline constraint from infra: can't run compat proxy longer than 90 days without cost spike. We need to publish clear sunset date in partner dashboard.
Anya K.: For SI customers, recommend 90-day extended migration window if they opt into paid migration support.
Priya S.: Action items:
- Anya: partner one-pager + emails (due 1729200000)
- Mike: SDK helper + sample PR (due 1729000000)
- Eli: spin up compat proxy plan + rate limits (due 1728920000)
- Jordan: hardware retest checklist (due 1729040000)
I'll put these in the partner tracker and ping hands-off list.
Mike L.: I'll also open a small RFC in eng-platform for the protobuf change and add "feature flag:enable_v4_schema" toggles.
Anya K.: Good. Also let's sync with legal for joint announcement embargos (Eli, can you loop them in?)
Eli R.: Looping legal now. @legal-team please advise on embargo wording and joint announcement constraints.
Priya S.: Cool — I'll follow up with a short partner town hall next week. :microscope:
Mike L.: LGTM :thumbsup:
